estimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, no online trophies (PowerPyx). No mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave (PowerPyx). Never use cheats on your trophy save: they disable trophies and saving (PowerPyx).
savePlan: Slot 1 — start of Chapter 1 (keep until Positive Mental Attitude pops)
Slot 6 — just before the final mission (untouched)
Remaining slots — rotate for free-roam cleanup

stages.text: Finish Chapters 1–5 and the story missions. This earns all 12 story trophies plus the gold for the final mission. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only trophy with a missable moment. Along the way, finish an arcade game, beat Cal at fishing, and scan vehicles and locations with the WAiNK app as you go so the grinds start early.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story (60–80 hours)

stages.text: Finish the six side-character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. None of these are missable — every quest giver returns after the story — but do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3, because it is time-sensitive. Andy is Lucia-only; Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Side stories (Strangers & Freaks and the six finales)

stages.text: Open the robbery toolset in Chapters 3–4: the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, bank vaults from That's Where The Money Is. Rob 5 vaults, an armored truck and a jewelry store unseen, hit 3 shops in a row with your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level together, rob one illegal operation per gang, and launder $250,000 in Marked Bills. Steal the VCIA jet and a Rhino tank while you are out, and rob Kingpin Bowling for Let's Go Bowling.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Robberies and duo trophies

stages.text: After the credits, the 100% Completion checklist appears (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion). Work it in free roam: 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Finish the remaining activities, races, shooting-range golds, drone races, card sets, WAiNK scans, meditations, garages and Scooter Bros registrations. Most of the grind trophies pop along the way.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Cleanup, collectibles and the 100% checklist (about 100 hours)

stages.text: Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the 54th other trophy does. A Long Road (100% completion) is the last big gate for most hunters — PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy — so leave the checklist for last and let everything else feed into it.
stages.title: Stage 5 — The Platinum
